viewer.clip.title: Clipboard
viewer.clip.placeholder: Text the host copies shows up here. Type or paste text here to send it to the host.
viewer.clip.readTitle: Read this computer's clipboard and send it to the host
viewer.clip.copyTitle: Copy this text to this computer's clipboard
viewer.clip.sendTitle: Put this text on the host's clipboard
viewer.clip.tooLarge: That text is too large to send (the limit is 1 MB).
viewer.clip.sent: Sent. Paste on the host as usual.
viewer.clip.copyBlocked: The browser didn't allow copying. Press Ctrl+C to copy the selected text.
viewer.clip.readSent: Sent your clipboard to the host.
viewer.clip.readBlocked: The browser didn't allow reading the clipboard. Paste into the box with Ctrl+V instead.
viewer.clip.titleUnavailable: Clipboard: not available on this host
viewer.clip.titlePending: Clipboard: the host copied text; click the screen to copy it here
viewer.clip.noteUnavailable: The host's clipboard can't be shared.

viewer.clip.noteOff: Automatic sync is off. Move text by hand with the box below.
viewer.clip.notePending: The host copied text. Click the remote screen or press a key there to put it on this computer's clipboard, or use Copy here.
viewer.clip.noteSynced: Copy on either side and paste on the other. Ctrl+V on the remote screen sends your text to the host first.
viewer.clip.noteInsecure: This page isn't HTTPS, so text the host copies lands here after your next click or key on the remote screen.

viewer.set.title: Settings
viewer.set.old: This host doesn't support stream settings.
viewer.set.actualTitle: One stream pixel per screen pixel; scroll with the scrollbars
viewer.set.autoHideTitle: While connected, folds the toolbar away after a few seconds without the pointer near it. Move the pointer to the top edge, or tap the tab there, to bring it back
viewer.set.hardwareTitle: Keys by position: the host's keyboard layout decides the characters. Best for shortcuts and games
viewer.set.textTitle: Types the characters of this computer's keyboard layout, whatever the host's layout is. Shortcuts still go by key position
viewer.set.wheelTitle: Turns the scroll direction around, like natural scrolling on a touchpad
viewer.set.awakeTitle: While connected and idle, presses F15 on the host now and then so it doesn't lock or sleep

viewer.set.awakeChoice.other: Press F15 on the host after {n} seconds without input

viewer.set.appliedScaled: The host sends up to {fps} fps at up to {mbit} Mbit/s, at 1/{n} resolution.

viewer.keys.cadTitleLinux: Send Ctrl+Alt+Del to the host (GNOME: log out / power off dialog)
settings.title: Dalker Settings
settings.expired: This settings page has expired. Close the window and open Dalker Settings again.
settings.signInFirst: Sign in to the web client first.
settings.web.title: Web Remote Access
settings.web.sub: View and control this computer from a web browser over WebRTC.
settings.web.warning: When disabled, the browser server stops and everyone watching is disconnected at once.
settings.web.loopback: Only browsers on this computer can open it.
settings.web.localOnly: This address works only on this computer. Choose a network address for other computers.
settings.web.network: Open it in a browser on another computer on the same network.
settings.web.turnedOn: Web server turned on. Dalker applies it within a few seconds.
settings.web.turnedOff: Web server turned off. Dalker applies it within a few seconds.
settings.web.moves: Web server moves to port {port} within a few seconds.
settings.addressPick: Which of this computer's addresses to use
settings.addressCopied: The address is on the clipboard.
settings.port.taken: The other server already uses port {port}.
settings.pw.title: Access Password
settings.pw.none: No password: nobody can sign in

settings.pw.hint.one: At least {n} character. Changing it signs out everyone who is connected.
settings.pw.hint.other: At least {n} characters. Changing it signs out everyone who is connected.

settings.pw.tooShort.one: The password must have at least {n} character.
settings.pw.tooShort.other: The password must have at least {n} characters.

settings.pw.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
settings.pw.changed: Password changed. Everyone who was connected is signed out.
settings.share.title: Screen Sharing
settings.share.allowedHint: Viewers see the screen without anyone clicking Share here. Allow it again if you chose another monitor or revoked it.
settings.share.askHint: The first viewer waits until somebody here clicks Share. Allow it now, while you are at this computer.
settings.mcp.title: AI Agents (MCP)
settings.mcp.sub: Let AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor or LM Studio see the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, and share the clipboard.
settings.mcp.hostOnly: The MCP server is turned on and off on the host, in Dalker Settings.
settings.mcp.loopback: Only programs on the host computer can reach it. Use an SSH tunnel or VPN to reach it from elsewhere.
settings.mcp.network: Other computers on the network can connect too (plain HTTP, protected by the token).
settings.mcp.turnedOn: MCP server turned on. Dalker applies it within a few seconds.
settings.mcp.turnedOff: MCP server turned off. Dalker applies it within a few seconds.
settings.mcp.remoteOn: Other computers can now connect to the MCP server.
settings.mcp.remoteOff: Only this computer can connect to the MCP server now.
settings.mcp.moves: MCP server moves to port {port} within a few seconds.
settings.pill.webDown: Web server is on but not answering on port {port}: Dalker may not be running, may still be applying the change, or another program uses the port
settings.pill.mcpDown: MCP server is on but not answering on port {port}: Dalker may not be running, may still be applying the change, or another program uses the port
settings.tokens.title: Access Tokens
settings.tokens.savesNow: Saved as soon as you create or change them
settings.tokens.name: Name
settings.tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Generate one for each AI client that should connect.
settings.tokens.old: Made before Dalker kept tokens: only its hash is stored. Generate a new token to copy it.
settings.tokens.fullTitle: Screenshots, mouse and keyboard. Click to turn off.
settings.tokens.viewTitle: Screenshots only (made on the command line). Click to allow mouse and keyboard too.
settings.tokens.remoteOffTitle: Click to allow screenshots, mouse and keyboard.
settings.tokens.clipOnTitle: Reads and writes the clipboard. Click to turn off.
settings.tokens.configTitle: MCP configuration for Claude, Cursor or LM Studio
settings.tokens.permissionsChanged: Permissions of “{name}” changed. An AI agent using it reconnects with them.
settings.tokens.copiedNamed: The token “{name}” is on the clipboard.
settings.tokens.copied: The token is on the clipboard.
settings.tokens.enterName: Enter a name for the token.
settings.tokens.badName: Use up to 64 characters: letters, digits, spaces and - _ . @ only.
settings.tokens.duplicate: There is already a token named “{name}”.
settings.newToken.title: Generate a new token
settings.newToken.name: Name of the AI client that will use it
settings.newToken.remoteNote: See the screen, move and click the mouse, type.
settings.newToken.clipNote: Read and write this computer's clipboard.
settings.token.title: Token
settings.token.sub: Give it to the AI client as a bearer token, or copy a ready configuration. You can copy it again later from the token list.
settings.config.title: MCP configuration
settings.config.off: The MCP server is off: turn it on before connecting.
settings.config.copied: The configuration is on the clipboard.
settings.config.codeWhere: Run this in a terminal. It adds Dalker for your user only (in ~/.claude.json), so the token stays out of your projects.
settings.config.codeProjectWhere: Paste it into .mcp.json in your project. The token stays out of the file: set DALKER_MCP_TOKEN to the token (its copy button in the token list) where Claude Code starts, for example in your shell profile.
settings.config.cursorWhere: Paste it into the client's mcp.json (LM Studio: Program › Edit mcp.json). It contains the token: keep that file out of Git.
settings.config.desktopWhere: Paste it into claude_desktop_config.json (Settings › Developer › Edit Config). Needs Node.js: the mcp-remote bridge runs through npx.
settings.revoke.title: Revoke token?
settings.revoke.sub: AI agents using it are disconnected at once, and it can't be used again.
